name: Newspaper
tagline: A one-page morning broadsheet that explains how one thing works
description: Each morning it picks some corner of the world, reads up on it, and sets the result out as a single printable sheet under the masthead Understand the World. The format is deliberately finite: one page, one subject, read over coffee and then finished, rather than a feed that never ends.
author: Carbonthecoder
